info.name: InteliROI Backend — All Services
info.description:
# InteliROI API smoke / manual test collection

Test **each service individually** before Phase 10 (api-gateway).

## Setup
1. Import this collection + `InteliROI.local.postman_environment.json`
2. Select environment **InteliROI Local**
3. Start Postgres/Redis (`docker compose -f deployments/docker-compose.yml up -d`)
4. Migrate + run the service under test (see README / APPLICATION_FLOW.md)
5. Run **0. Health** folder first, then **1. Auth** Register/Login to fill `access_token`

## Body options
Request bodies include `_options` / `_howto` / `_alt_*` keys listing allowed values.
Those keys are **ignored by the API** — change the real field to the option you want.

## Ports
| Service | Port | Base var |
|---|---|---|
| auth | 8081 | auth_base |
| organization | 8082 | org_base |
| business-context | 8083 | bc_base |
| ai-gateway | 8084 | ai_base |
| usage-cost | 8085 | cost_base |
| roi-engine | 8086 | roi_base |
| analytics | 8087 | analytics_base |
| notification | 8088 | notify_base |
| billing | 8089 | billing_base |

item.name: 4. ai-gateway-service (:8084)

request.description: Set env openai_api_key (or paste key). Path uses {{provider_name}} default openai.
Revokes key. Re-configure before chat if you run this.

body.raw:
{
  "provider": "openai",
  "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
  "prompt": "Say hello in one short sentence.",
  "project_id": {{project_id}},
  "task_category_id": {{task_category_id}},
  "conversation_uuid": "",
  "_options": {
    "provider": [
      "openai",
      "anthropic",
      "google"
    ],
    "model": [
      "gpt-4o-mini",
      "gpt-4o",
      "claude-sonnet-4-20250514",
      "(must exist in seeded models for that provider)"
    ],
    "project_id": [
      {{project_id}},
      "omit/null"
    ],
    "task_category_id": [
      {{task_category_id}},
      "omit/null"
    ],
    "conversation_uuid": [
      "empty string = new conversation",
      "{{conversation_uuid}} to continue"
    ]
  },
  "_alt_continue_thread": {
    "provider": "openai",
    "model": "gpt-4o-mini",
    "prompt": "Follow up: what did I just ask?",
    "conversation_uuid": "{{conversation_uuid}}"
  },
  "_howto": "Fields named _options / _howto / _alt_* are IGNORED by the API (Go json ignores unknown keys). Pick a value from _options and put it on the real field. Delete _* keys before send if you prefer a clean body."
}

item.name: 10. Suggested happy-path order

request.description:
1. Health probes for services you started
2. Auth register/login
3. Org: department → team → project → assign user
4. BC: job-role → assign employee → task-category → benchmark → approve
5. AI: configure openai key → chat (saves request_uuid)
6. Start cost worker → check costs/summary + budgets
7. Start ROI worker → roi/company + feedback
8. Start analytics worker → analytics/company
9. Notify internal create + list inbox
10. Billing plans + me/subscription + usage

Optional: set BILLING_SERVICE_URL / NOTIFICATION_SERVICE_URL on callers when testing integrations.

item.description: Manual checklist (not automated). Workers needed after chat for cost → ROI → analytics.
